links.outcome: Reading level of LLM answers to androgenetic alopecia patient questions (Flesch-Kincaid)
links.effect: All three models generated responses at a high school reading level.
links.quote: All models generated responses at a high school reading level.

links.outcome: Presence of warnings about potential misinformation in Deepseek R1 responses
links.effect: Deepseek R1 lacked warnings about potential misinformation and frequently provided inaccurate content.
links.quote: It also lacked warnings about potential misinformation.

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the accuracy, readability, and user experience of three LLMs (ChatGPT 4.0, Gemini 1.5 Flash, Deepseek R1) answering patient questions on androgenetic alopecia without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
